subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Diagnosis of pregnancy and antenatal care schedules

steps.tx: **Diagnosis** (**amenorrhoea** with **morning sickness, breast tenderness, urinary frequency**; **Chadwick, Goodell, Hegar** signs, **uterine** 8 weeks orange 12 weeks pelvic; **urine hCG** missed week, **serum beta-hCG** doubling, **transvaginal sac** 5 weeks yolk 6 weeks cardiac 7 weeks) with **differentials** (ectopic, corpus luteum, fibroid, DUB) confirms; **dating** (**Naegele** 9 months 7 days, **first trimester CRL** gold, IVF transfer) locks EDD. Clinical plus biochemical plus scan triangulate.
steps.say: Missed period sickness tender breasts frequent urine is pregnancy: hCG sac cardiac triangulate. CRL dates gold.

steps.tx: **Dating scan** (**11 to 14 weeks** NT, nasal bone, ductus, **combined screening**, **NIPT** cell free high risk, **anomaly 18 to 20 weeks**, **growth 28 32 36 weeks**) with **EDD** (Naegele assumes 28 day, ultrasound overrides LMP uncertain) schedules; **twins** (chorionicity lambda T first trimester, fortnightly monochorionic) surveils. Nuchal plus biochemistry risks Down.
steps.say: Eleven fourteen NT combined anomaly eighteen twenty growth later: lambda T twins chorionicity. CRL overrides LMP.

steps.tx: **Visits** (**4 weekly to 28**, **2 weekly to 36**, **weekly after**; BP urine oedema fundal symphysis, **Hb** each trimester, **OGTT 24 to 28**, **HIV HBsAg VDRL** once, **TSH** high risk, **Td** 2 doses, **IFA** 180 days, **albendazole** second trimester, **counselling** birth plan breastfeeding) with **vaccines** (Td, flu inactivated, Tdap cocoon) protects; **weight** (11 to 16 kg normal BMI, fundal McDonald) tracks. MCP cards document.
steps.say: Four two weekly visits BP urine fundal Hb OGTT infections Td IFA deworm: cards document. Weight tracks.

steps.tx: **High risk** (**elderly primi, short stature, grand multi, prior section stillbirth preterm preeclampsia, anaemia, twins, breech, medical**; **referral** FRU CEmOC, **delivery planning** 37 to 39 indicated, **steroids** preterm, **anti-D** Rh negative) with **danger signs** (bleeding, headache visual, reduced movements, leaking, fever, convulsions) educates; **kick counts** 10 in 12 hours reassure. Risk tags colour code.
steps.say: Elderly short grand prior anaemic twins breech medical is high risk: FRU refers planned delivers. Kicks count reassure.
